summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for expanding TexERP with Supplier & Procurement Management, End-to-End Document Chaining (Quote -> Work Order -> Invoice -> Packing List), Fabric Roll & Dye-Lot Traceability with Defect Logging, Multi-Currency Exchange Rates, Barcode/QR Lookup, Role-Based Approval Gates, Interactive Financial & Stock Charts, and Printable/Shareable Document Exports on top of the offline-first Room SQLite database.
